objective: Retire remaining production consumers of legacy economic mechanisms and mature Treasury Economic Intelligence without introducing a second economic authority.

rulesConsidered: Treasurer remains the sole production economic admission and settlement authority.
Economic Intelligence is read-only and advisory.
Legacy economic modules cannot authorize production spend.
Workers, routers, Ascalon and intelligence do not receive Treasury mutation authority.
F07 remains an independent verification boundary.
Existing current-main compute, notebook, ReMaker and provider contracts must not regress.

notes: Wave 5 adds a static production authority scan.
Economic Intelligence exposes no Treasury write handle.
Legacy provider fallback remains only behind non-production compatibility behavior.

conflicts.originalConflict: AgentEconomicsEngine remained instantiated in the verified-trajectory production controller path after Treasury became authoritative.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Decouple CognitiveOutcomeLearner from the concrete economic engine and keep only a generic telemetry-sink seam.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: AutonomousFactoryController no longer instantiates AgentEconomicsEngine; historical tests may use the generic sink for compatibility.

conflicts.originalConflict: Economic Intelligence could accidentally become a second economic authority if it received Treasury mutation APIs.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Create read-only analytics and a separate bounded projection type with no Treasury service handle.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: TreasuryEconomicIntelligence is read-only; TreasuryEconomicAdvice is SHADOW_ONLY and canAuthorizeSpend=false.

conflicts.originalConflict: Legacy quota data remained a second admission source during migration.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Use legacy quota only for first-time Treasury entitlement bootstrap and compatibility projection.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: TreasuryQuotaAdmission reads/mutates Treasury after bootstrap; Firestore cannot override Treasury state.

changes: Removed production CostGovernor use from capability routing.
Removed MissionBudgetManager economic admission from MissionManager.
Removed AgentEconomicsEngine from AutonomousFactoryController production graph.
Added machine-enforced production compatibility retirement scan.
Added historical spend baseline and anomaly intelligence.
Added verified render and verified short unit economics using Treasury settlement evidence.
Added reservation right-sizing metrics and bounded spend forecasts.
Added verification receipt persistence to RESOURCE_CONSUMED evidence.
Added read-only TreasuryEconomicAdvice projection for Overseer/Ascalon/GLiDE.
Added dedicated Wave-5 validation workflow and operator documentation.
verificationPlan: Treasury authority and compatibility retirement tests.
Current-main ComputePool, ReMaker, Overseer, F06/F07 and repository CI regressions.
